Education

  1. September 2024 – September 2026

    M.Sc. in Computer Science (LM-18)

    University of Salerno · Fisciano (SA), Italy

    Master's degree focused on engineering AI-enabled systems, software quality and project management. My thesis investigated how readability-related metrics of developers' prompts are associated with multiple quality dimensions of LLM-generated code.

    • Curriculum: Software Engineering & IT Management
    • Final grade: 110/110 cum laude with special mention
    • Thesis: "From Prompt Quality to Code Quality: an Empirical Study on Developer-LLM Conversations"
    • Advisor: Prof. Fabio Palomba
    • Co-advisor: Dott. Antonio Della Porta
    • Excellence Program 2025/2026: worked on an LLM-based Clinical Decision Support System
  2. September 2021 – September 2024

    B.Sc. in Computer Science (L-31)

    University of Salerno · Fisciano (SA), Italy

    Bachelor's degree where the Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence course sparked my interest in SE4AI and AI4SE. My thesis presented CAMILLE, an open-source Rasa chatbot integrated into a Visual Studio Code extension that explains ML-specific code smells, analyzes repositories and suggests refactorings through GPT-4o mini.

    • Final grade: 110/110 cum laude
    • Thesis: "CAMILLE: a Chatbot for the Identification and Removal of ML-Specific Code Smells"
    • Advisor: Prof. Fabio Palomba
    • Co-advisors: Dott. Gilberto Recupito, Dott. Giammaria Giordano
